description: Under SealedAttempt, once one participant completes their attempt and the other has not, the opponent's attempt status is visible but their result is not.
notes: This is the one concept both sides already implement identically without having shared any code: Unity's VersusGame.ViewFor and the Backend's VersusSeries.ToRoundView both reveal opponent attempt state but seal the opponent's score until the round resolves. This fixture locks that convergence in.
